labels.name: question
labels.rationale: The reporter asks how to contribute and when external PRs are allowed.

items.body:
Please describe the broken-link correction in an issue first. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution steps and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) if you use AI; AI-generated PRs need a linked issue or discussion with maintainer approval.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
